source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 May 1952, p. 6
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the nine electoral divisions of Belfast rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Only Whitehouse was contested; J. C. Taggart was returned unopposed at Ballysillan after a withdrawal. Returned unopposed after the withdrawal of Mr. Wilson Cupples' opponent; Taggart was the youngest candidate in the Ulster local elections. Returned unopposed.
